case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You described a cost environment where alloy and bar-steel inputs weigh heavily on your price. Option A answers that with a longer contract term and a clear, simple structure that you can confirm as it stands.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On our own order history:
Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.95; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: it gives you a contract term twice the length of your offer, and the cost lines above are moving down, not up.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As your offer is a decision for more than one desk, please take Option A to the person who approves pricing on your side. We would also like to see how your calculation is built:

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change data you cited, that is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. 

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We treat our internal cost breakdown as confidential and cannot share it, but we are pleased to offer a revised price of EUR 5.34 per unit for this indexed package.

To confirm a 24-month term as proposed in your options, we require an AS-14404 index clause, as we cannot offer fixed pricing over such a long period. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. We can accept the 45-day payment term from your Option C, and while we note your index data, our alloy costs are currently covered at fixed prices, limiting immediate reductions.

For our agreement, we offer a price of €5.34 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Thank you for reaching out to us. To answer your question regarding Option A: we can agree to the 90-day payment term and 24-month contract, provided the AS-14404 index clause is applied. As previously stated, we cannot carry the risk of fixed pricing over a two-year period. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current Angebot is a price of €5.05 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 90 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.22 per unit for a price of €5.22 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
